example_en: She hopes to qualify (as a lawyer) at the end of the year.
example_zh: 她希望在年底取得（律師）資格。

example_en: They had a bitter quarrel about/over some money three years ago and they haven't spoken to each other since.
example_zh: 他們三年前因為錢的問題有過一次激烈的爭吵，從此以後就互不理睬了。

example_en: If you have any queries about your treatment, the doctor will answer them.
example_zh: 您如果對治療有任何疑問，醫生將會做出解答。
